name: yo-prefix-enter-finds-the-favourite
description: 'go' and 'gi' were fixed to open their engine on Enter, but a prefix that ALSO names a favourite regressed: Enter on the engine row opened a second tab instead of switching to the favourite's own. The fixture's favourite sits on youtube.com while the seeded engine's own template URL resolves to www.youtube.com - the exact host mismatch that bit, so a fix that only string-matched the two would still fail here. The favourite's title deliberately does not start with 'yo', so the typed prefix scores only the engine row, not a favourites-lead row - Tab's own scoping behaviour is unaffected and is not what this scenario measures.
